newsitem.title: ITALY: European car sales seen down 1.0 pct in Feb - Anfia.
newsitem.headline: European car sales seen down 1.0 pct in Feb - Anfia.

text.p: Overall European car sales in February totalled 1,037,300 units, a fall of one percent on the same month in 1996, provisional data from Italian carmakers' association Anfia showed.
Anfia said in a statement that the good performance of the Italian market, however, with new registrations up 21.45 percent, had helped to limit the loss.
In the first two months of 1997, Anfia said the European market fell 1.7 percent with a total of 2,168,000 registrations.
In France, February sales slumped 24.8 percent. In Germany they fell by 1.3 percent, but grew 2.6 percent in Spain and 1.9 percent in Britain.

Cumulative sales for the first two months of the year showed a fall of 29.3 percent in France and of 2.8 percent in Germany, but a rise of 11 percent in Spain and an increase of 5.1 percent in Britain, Anfia said.
